name: Search Term Co-Occurrence Matrix (Market Basket of Search Queries)
description: To suggest related searches, engines analyze queries searched together in the same session (e.g. users searching 'monitor' also search 'hdmi cable' 42% of the time).
prompt:
To suggest related searches, engines analyze queries searched together in the same session (e.g. users searching 'monitor' also search 'hdmi cable' 42% of the time).

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: term_a, term_b, cooccurrence_count.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Find pairs of terms most frequently searched in the same user session
            SELECT 
                a.term AS term_a,
                b.term AS term_b,
                COUNT(*) AS cooccurrence_count
            FROM session_searches a
            JOIN session_searches b
              ON a.session_id = b.session_id
             AND a.term < b.term
            GROUP BY a.term, b.term
            ORDER BY cooccurrence_count DESC, term_a, term_b;
why_it_fails: Self-joining search sessions without ordering (`a.term < b.term`) doubles matrix size with duplicate reversed pairs.
